headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录286篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究208篇, 开源项目40篇, 模型发布35篇, 产品/API3篇。热门标签：Agent（73篇）。其中15%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ vectorize-io /hindsight：Hindsight: Agent Memory That Learns

▸ paperclipai /paperclip：The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work

▸ t8y2 /dbx：25 MB lightweight cross-platform database client for 100+ databases, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQ

▸ mvschwarz /openrig：Multi-agent harness that runs Claude Code and Codex together as one system
